mapper.insert: insert into play_run_start_mode (member_id, activity_id, topic_id, run_mode, alt_station_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{runMode}, #{altStationId}, now()) on duplicate key update run_mode = values(run_mode), alt_station_id = values(alt_station_id), create_time = values(create_time)
mapper.delete: delete from play_run_start_mode where member_id = #{memberId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.select: select id, name, longitude, latitude from cms_topic_alt_station where topic_id = #{topicId} and status = 1 order by id limit 20
